subject: Request: POC runway + discretionary credits for Aurora Tech evaluation
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@auroratech.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Tech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: POC runway + discretionary credits for Aurora Tech evaluation

Hi Nikhil,

Quick context: Aurora is expanding the scope of the pilot to include a second business unit (regulatory summaries) and needs more runway to finish the integrated evaluation. We’re about 85% through accuracy checks but increased input length and higher concurrency have pushed through our free sandbox balance.

Ask: can Redwood extend the POC window by two weeks and provide a one-off discretionary credit to cover an additional ~60k tokens worth of inference? Our procurement team is ready to sign a short addendum but needs confirmation of the concession before we route paperwork.

Why this matters: Aurora is targeting a procurement decision in Q1; this workstream is cited by their VP of Product as critical to the pilot outcome. If we can complete the extended tests the likelihood of an expansion (dedicated capacity) increases materially.

I’ve attached the latest evaluation metrics and an updated scope (PDF). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director of ML Integrations
Aurora Tech

Attachments: aurora_evaluation_metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet), aurora_poc_scope.pdf (pdf)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@auroratech.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: POC runway + discretionary credits for Aurora Tech evaluation

Elena — thanks for the note and the attachments, I reviewed the metrics briefly. Appreciate the extra color on the business unit expansion.

I’ll escalate to Deal Desk + Jordan for one-time approval. Can you confirm:
- expected additional token consumption (approx 60k you mentioned)
- whether Aurora will need more than two weeks if we grant credits (they indicated Q1 decision)
- any regulatory controls or data residency needs tied to the new unit (so I can flag Security/Private team if required)

If you can reply with those three items, I’ll include them in the approval note.

—Nikhil
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 07:25:00 -0800
Subject: EQ: Aurora Tech — request for 2-week POC extension + discretionary 60k-token credit (deal RWIN-2026-5482)

Team — need a quick exec/Deal Desk decision for Aurora Tech. Summary below; please see attached metrics and scope from the customer.

Customer: Aurora Tech (VP Product engaged).
Ask: 2-week POC extension + one-off discretionary credit ~60k tokens (~$X equivalent) to complete tests for an expanded regulatory summaries use case. Procurement will sign an addendum if we confirm concession.
Why approve: high likelihood of expansion to dedicated capacity in Q1 (customer cited), product leadership actively evaluating, and technical blockers are all test-completion related (not infra).
Risks: precedent-setting for PLG free limits; asks exceed standard one-time sandbox boosts. Proposed guardrails: approval limited to this deal id, credits expire in 30 days, provide visibility in Console, require usage milestone (completion report) before further concessions.

Metrics (from attachments): 12k tokens/day baseline, spike to 22k/day during extended tests, current remaining free credits exhausted.

Recommended ask for approval: one-time 60k-token credit + 2-week window. No SLA changes. Require short completion summary and adoption check-in with CS within 30 days.

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / MODIFY. I’ve tagged deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/aurora-tech and attached the evaluation metrics.

Thanks,
Nikhil
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EQ: Aurora Tech — request for 2-week POC extension + discretionary 60k-token credit (deal RWIN-2026-5482)

Nikhil — thanks for the concise brief and the proposed guardrails. I’m inclined to approve a constrained concession here given the strategic upside and VP-level engagement.

Decision: APPROVE one-time discretionary credit = 60,000 tokens and a 14-calendar-day POC extension. Conditions:
- Credits issued only for Deal ID RWIN-2026-5482 and expire 30 days after issuance.
- CS must confirm completion report (one-page summary) that shows key acceptance metrics met within the extended window.
- No further credits or term changes without renewed exec approval.
- Finance to record as promotional credit (no refund entitlements).

Marissa/Aditya: please action the credit in Billing and notify Procurement + Procurement contact at Aurora. Marissa, can you draft the one-line addendum language for procurement to sign (short statement: 2-week extension + one-time 60k-token credit, credits expire 30 days)? I’ll sign off on the exec note.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena@auroratech.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Tech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: POC runway + discretionary credits for Aurora Tech evaluation

This is fantastic — thank you, Jordan and team. We’ll review the addendum when Marissa shares it and route to Procurement for signature. We expect the extra tokens and two weeks will be sufficient to complete the regulatory summary batch tests.

Elena
